suggestions.expectation: Every read, review or verification that the session file's Outcome / Open at end / Narrative and the reply's Shipped line attribute to this conversation appears as a step in transcript.md ...
suggestions.reason: transcript.md is written by the executor after the fact, so a 'cat step reaching its end' is self-reported. A fabricated-but-plausible read would pass. If the harness can capture a raw tool log (or the executor is required to paste the last lines of each full read), the expectation becomes verifiable rather than trust-based.

No expectation checks that the handoff is consistent with what the run itself discovered: the session file and OVERVIEW say 'nothing stale found' while the transcript flags the README index row as stale and the commit fixes it. Consider an expectation that the Narrative/Open at end account for every change in the handoff commit (here: the regenerated index row), so a handoff cannot both ship a fix and claim nothing was found.

No expectation covers the OVERVIEW.md edit (Status 'In flight' bullet + Next up item 1), which is the largest hunk in the handoff commit (15 lines) and the thing a rehydrating conversation reads first. A wrong or missing OVERVIEW update would pass all five expectations. Consider checking that OVERVIEW's Next up item 1 names the ADR pass / SES-006 and that overview.diff is limited to the Status and Next up sections.

eval_feedback.overall: All five expectations pass on verified fixture state. The expectations are discriminating on git state, the session-tool gate and the reply, but the transcript-evidence expectation depends on an executor-authored transcript, and the OVERVIEW hand-off edit and internal consistency of the 'nothing stale' claim are unchecked.
